revisionDetails.rationale: Revise the primary proposal so the Portuguese participle agrees with the ICU branch: “episódio atribuído” for one and “episódios atribuídos” for other.

additionalMissedRefinements.rationale: The caller uses {arr} as the service name in “Remove from {arr}”; this Hindi order says remove {arr} from, reversing the argument. Put the placeholder before “से हटाएँ”.
The non-privileged caller renders this field as a relative request date only. The current “Solicitado” is less clear than a date label; “Fecha de solicitud” names that value.
The current phrase reads like “no identification marks” and mismatches Arabic agreement. “وسوم” is the UI term for tags and agrees with “لا توجد”.
This is a disclosure button. The current Arabic says only “Options”; the proposal restores the source action “Show”.
The current bare noun sequence “ID MusicBrainz” is awkward Portuguese. “ID do MusicBrainz” matches the neighboring ID labels and preserves the protected brand.
The button label currently omits the article in “todas as solicitações”. The proposed wording is grammatical and preserves “Show All Requests”.
The caller displays a publication year after this label. “Primeiro Publicado” is an awkward adjective as a field label; “Primeira publicação” names the date field.
The current value contains a Simplified Chinese character in the Traditional Chinese catalog (“滤”). This Traditional Chinese section heading preserves “Media Filters” and fixes the script mismatch.
The caller groups request-status filters here; “工作过滤器” both uses a Simplified character and renders “Task” as generic work. “任務篩選” fits the Traditional Chinese section label.
This is the fallback heading for Advanced Request. “Cấp cao” suggests a high-ranking request; “nâng cao” is the ordinary Vietnamese UI term for advanced.

lowConfidenceNotes.note: The fallback modal heading is “Advanced Request”; current “متقدم” says only “Advanced”. “طلب متقدم” may preserve the noun more fully, but retain current pending Arabic native review because a heading-style elliptical adjective may be intentional.
